title: security: an unrestricted reader of a controlled_by_parent detail with a required FK drops the vacuous parent-chain leaf (epic #33631 R4)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cztR1A2CZoxSZyuoGP

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #33631 (SQL performance; maintainer's direct word on the epic). Item R4 of the M0 ranked list (#33633): https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/33631#issuecomment-6889544281, corrected by https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/33631#issuecomment-6889939163 (review#2 PASS 6890102899).

## Maintainer ruling (seat decision card, 2026-11-15T06:40Z)

「只在父字段必填时去掉」: for an unrestricted (admin) reader of a `controlled_by_parent` detail, drop the vacuous parent-chain leaf **only when the controlling FK is required**. When the FK is nullable, keep the chain, so orphan details (master gone or unset) stay hidden exactly as today. No change to which rows any reader sees.

## Today

`engine-readable-ids-permission-formula.ts` ~207 composes `ReadableIds.compose(leaf, undefined)` with the leaf from `security-plugin-cbp-read-filter.ts` ~156, so an admin read carries `fk IN (SELECT id FROM master WHERE fk2 IN (SELECT id FROM master2))`; the analytics path ANDs the same chain twice.

## Measured (1M rows)

Dropping the leaf: page SQLite 397 → 281 ms, PG 97 → 56 ms; total SQLite 217 → 136 ms, PG 78 → 54 ms (−29% to −42%, twice per list). It also unlocks the SQLite half of the `created_at` index card (1.7 s → 0.09 ms).

## Rules

- Parity test: the same admin read with the chain and without it returns the same rows when the FK is required; a nullable-FK object keeps the chain (orphan row stays hidden, pinned).
- Restricted readers are untouched.

## Business reason

Every admin list, count and aggregate over a detail object pays for a security subquery that cannot filter anything when the parent is mandatory.

## Reader

domain:server#5 area A2 (plugin-security cbp leaf) with A4 (objectql ReadableIds compose), next account; size S–M.

## Dedupe

Covered by the M0 inventory; no open card on `ReadableIds.compose` vacuous leaf.
